column1: 20001§delve§delv§Thomas Hardy is delving into matters we all recognise because they are common to humanity.§托马斯·哈代正在**探究**的是我们都能辨识的事物，因为它们是人类所共有的。§
20002§exact§ɪgˈzækt§What is the exact amount left in your savings account?§你储蓄账户上的**准确**余额是多少？§
20003§elicit§ɪˈlɪsɪt§The students then were randomly assigned to watch a video clip eliciting either humour, contentment, or neutral feelings.§然后，学生们被随机分配观看一段视频，这些视频要么**激发**幽默感、满足感，要么不激发情感变化。§
20004§traditional§trəˈdɪʃənl§Rosewood is a pure example of a traditional country house of this part of England.§红木建筑是英格兰这个地区**传统**乡间住宅的一个典型代表。§
20005§lack§læk§Martin can't afford the book due to lack of money.§由于**缺**钱，马丁买不起这本书。§
20006§regent§ˈriːdʒənt§George acted as a regent when the present king was a child.§当现任国王还是孩子时，乔治担任**摄政王**。§
20007§burgeon§ˈbɜːdʒən§To serve the burgeoning tourist industry, an array of professionals has emerged.§为了满足**日益繁荣**的旅游业的发展需求，一大批专业人员已经出现了。§
20008§argue§ˈɑːgjuː§The study argues that the type of action needed against passive smoking should be similar to that being taken against other diseases.§该研究**认为**人们需要采取类似防范其他疾病的行动来防范被动吸烟。§
20009§barely§ˈbeəli§Rainfall barely penetrates the soil in this area.§在该地区，降雨**很少**渗入土壤。§
20010§hierarchy§ˈhaɪərɑːki§It is likely that all uniforms make symbolic sense, namely, denoting a hierarchy.§很可能所有的制服都具有象征意义，即体现了穿衣人的**等级**。§
20011§guidance§ˈgaɪdns§We will solicit guidance and aid from legal experts.§我们将向法律专家寻求**指导**和帮助。§
20012§easy-going§ˌiːzi ˈɡəʊɪŋ§The interviews don't tell you if applicants are easy-going or hate smoking or whatever.§从面试中你看不出求职者是否**随和**或者讨厌吸烟之类的。§
20013§electrical§ɪˈlektrɪkl§The small battery-powered gadget can deliver subliminal electrical pulses to the skin.§这种小的电池驱动装置可以向皮肤传达微小的**电**脉冲。§
20014§electronic§ɪˌlekˈtrɒnɪk§Computers make up the so-called electronic media.§所谓的**电子**媒介是由计算机构成的。§改例句：make up of 是语法错误，删去 of
20015§philosophy§fəˈlɒsəfi§Try your best to succeed—that's my philosophy.§竭尽全力，取得成功——这就是我的**人生哲学**。§
20016§chronic§ˈkrɒnɪk§Jim suffers from chronic back pain after the car-wreck.§车祸后吉姆**一直**受背痛的折磨。§

20017§desirable§dɪˈzaɪərəbl§Selecting the right person for the job involves more than identifying the essential or desirable range of skills.§为一份工作选择合适的人选，不能只看此人是否拥有胜任这份工作的基本技能和**理想的**专长。§改译文：原译“相应专长”没有译出 desirable（理想的、可取的），把“相应”改为“理想的”
20018§consortium§kənˈsɔːtɪəm§The consortium that won the contract for the island opted for an aggressive approach.§赢得这座岛屿（开发）合同的**财团**采取了一种野蛮的开发方式。§
20019§buckle§ˈbʌkl§Buildings, pipes and roads tend to buckle and crack because of the movement of the earth.§由于地壳的运动，建筑物、地下管道以及道路等往往会**变形**甚至破裂。§
20020§curry§ˈkʌri§Which kind of curry do you like, mild or peppery?§你喜欢哪种**咖喱**，微辣的还是辛辣的？§
20021§subliminal§ˌsʌbˈlɪmɪnl§How we look sends all sorts of subliminal messages to other people.§我们的外表向其他人传达了各种**潜在**的信息。§
20022§chamber§ˈtʃeɪmbə(r)§In the brood chamber below, the bees will stash honey to eat later.§在**蜂巢**的下部，蜜蜂会贮藏蜂蜜，以供日后食用。§
20023§frequent§ˈfriːkwənt§Frequent failures did not affect his morale.§**屡屡**失败并未让他泄气。§
20024§prosperous§ˈprɒspərəs§My grandfather once was a prosperous British businessman.§我祖父曾是一名**成功**的英国商人。§改例句：Britain 是名词，作定语应为形容词 British
20025§purpose§ˈpɜːpəs§Bob was absent from school on purpose.§鲍勃**故意**逃学了。§
20026§variety§vəˈraɪəti§The places we will visit offer a variety of shopping.§我们将参观的地方可提供**各种**购物活动。§改例句：句末漏了句号
20027§immigration§ˌɪmɪˈgreɪʃn§There will be stricter controls on immigration into the country.§以后要**移民**到这个国家会面临更严格的管制。§
20028§natural§ˈnætʃrəl§It's natural for an old man of his age to be so calm.§处于他这般年纪的老人如此镇静是很**自然**的。§
20029§bet§bet§Anyway I bet there are some things you didn't know about bananas.§不管怎样，我**敢说**对于香蕉，你肯定有不知道的地方。§
20030§consumer§kənˈsjuːmə(r)§Many consumers feel that government and business have taken on the environmental agenda.§许多**消费者**认为政府和商家已经将环保提上了日程。§
20031§physician§fɪˈzɪʃn§The physician said smoking was harmful to my health.§那位**医生**说吸烟对我的健康有害。§
20032§equal§ˈiːkwəl§These four firms had equal levels of productivity.§这四家公司的生产力水平**不相上下**。§
20033§resort§rɪˈzɔːt§The east coast resorts are only a short twenty-minute drive from here.§从这儿开车去东海岸的**度假胜地**只需短短20分钟。§

20034§leadership§ˈliːdəʃɪp§Last week we talked about the most effective ways of leading meetings, and the advantages and disadvantages of different leadership styles.§上周，我们讨论了主持会议最有效的方法以及不同**主持**风格的利弊。§
20035§equity§ˈekwəti§The equity of the committee's decision was accepted by everyone.§委员会所做决定的**公正性**得到了大家的一致认可。§
20036§excavate§ˈekskəveɪt§Some large species of dung beetles originating from France excavate tunnels to a depth of approximately 30 cm below the dung pat.§一些源自法国的大型蜣螂品种会在粪堆下**挖**一条大约30厘米深的隧道。§
20037§nuclear§ˈnjuːklɪə(r)§France derives three quarters of its electricity from nuclear power.§法国四分之三的电来自**核**能。§
20038§mutual§ˈmjuːtʃuəl§They soon discovered a mutual interest in music.§很快，他们发现他们对音乐有着**共同**的兴趣。§
20039§density§ˈdensəti§The house has some high-density insulation materials in the roof.§房子的屋顶采用了一些高**密度**的绝缘材料。§
20040§massive§ˈmæsɪv§In Tokyo builders are planning a massive underground city to be begun in the next decade.§在东京，建筑者们正计划在接下来的十年里建造一个**大型**地下城。§
20041§congratulate§kənˈɡrætʃəleɪt§I wanted to congratulate you all on having passed the exam.§大家都通过了考试，我向你们**表示祝贺**。§
20042§companion§kəmˈpænɪən§Tom was my only Chinese companion during my stay in Switzerland.§汤姆是我在瑞士期间唯一的中国**伙伴**。§
20043§rig§rɪg§The defeated candidate claimed that the election was rigged.§落选的候选者称选举被人**操纵**了。§
20044§input§ˈɪnpʊt§The intensity of farming in the rich world should decline, and the use of chemical inputs will diminish.§富裕国家应该降低农业生产的密度，这样化学**药品**的使用将会减少。§
20045§merely§ˈmɪəli§You don't have to be present. Merely send a letter of explanation.§你不一定非出席不可，**只要**寄封信去说明一下就可以了。§
20046§impart§ɪmˈpɑːt§He told me not to impart it to anyone without his own permission.§他告诉我，未经他本人允许不可以把此事**透露**给任何人。§
20047§forfeit§ˈfɔːfɪt§He forfeited his driving licence because he drove after drinking.§他因酒后驾车**被没收**了驾照。§
20048§counteract§ˌkaʊntərˈækt§Antacid will counteract the excess acid in your stomach.§解酸剂会**中和**胃里过剩的酸。§
20049§ventilation§ˌventɪˈleɪʃn§In the noisiest areas mechanical ventilation will have to be installed in the exterior walls.§在噪音最大的区域，必须在外墙安装机械**通风设备**。§
20050§intermediate§ˌɪntəˈmiːdiət§Students who have reached an intermediate level benefit from learning general English skills.§那些英语水平达到**中级**的学生从英语综合技能学习中受益匪浅。§
20051§eternal§ɪˈtɜːnl§The supersession of the old by the new is a general, eternal and inviolable law of the universe.§新旧更迭是宇宙间普遍的、**永恒**的、不可违背的规律。§
20052§invasion§ɪnˈveɪʒn§The freedom from foreign invasion enables a country to develop its natural resources steadily.§不受外来**侵略**可以使一国的自然资源得到稳定的开发。§
20053§nevertheless§ˌnevəðəˈles§He was tired. Nevertheless he kept on working.§他累了，**不过**他仍然继续工作。§

20054§celebrate§ˈselɪbreɪt§The architectural style celebrated scientific and engineering achievements by openly parading the sophisticated techniques used in construction.§该建筑风格通过公开展示建筑中使用的先进技术来**歌颂**科学和工程方面的成就。§
20055§inspiring§ɪnˈspaɪərɪŋ§King was an inspiring tutor.§金是一位**激励人心**的导师。§
20056§attendance§əˈtendəns§I do not think there is a need to take class attendance every day at universities.§我认为在大学里没必要每天**点名**。§改例句：“点名”的固定搭配是 take attendance，make 用词错
20057§optional§ˈɒpʃənl§Is geography an optional course, or does everyone have to learn it?§地理是**选修**课吗，还是每个人都必须学习它？§
20058§heal§hiːl§The wound took months to heal.§这个伤口花了几个月才**愈合**。§
20059§enable§ɪˈneɪbl§The bank service enables you to withdraw cash from your account at any time.§这种银行服务**使你能**随时从账户中取钱。§
20060§dismantle§dɪsˈmæntl§Most people have been forced to dismantle their individualistic homes and return to more conventional lifestyles.§大多数人被迫**拆除**了他们极具个性的房子，回归更加传统的生活方式。§
20061§wage§weɪdʒ§In this company, wages are paid at the end of every month.§这家公司每到月末发**工资**。§
20062§landscape§ˈlændskeɪp§The landscape on the altiplano is the most beautiful I've ever seen.§高原上的**风景**是我所见过的最美的景色。§
20063§emotion§ɪˈməʊʃn§Doing sports can be a good way to release suppressed emotion.§做运动是一个释放压抑**情绪**的好方法。§
20064§commonwealth§ˈkɒmənwelθ§George was a scientist at the Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation at that time.§那时乔治是（澳大利亚）**联邦**科学与工业研究组织的一名科学家。§

20065§newsletter§ˈnjuːzletə(r)§There's David West who has volunteered to be the club secretary, and one of the many jobs he will have is to send out newsletters to you regularly.§那位就是戴维·韦斯特，他自愿做俱乐部秘书，他有许多工作，其中之一就是定期给你们分发**时事通讯**。§
20066§periodical§ˌpɪəriˈɒdɪkl§The professor's paper has been issued in the latest periodical.§教授的论文已经发表在最新的一期**期刊**上。§
20067§receptionist§rɪˈsepʃənɪst§The patient goes to a receptionist and asks her about his disease.§那个病人走向**接待员**，向她询问他的病情。§改例句：主语 The patient 是第三人称单数，ask 应为 asks
20068§security§sɪˈkjʊərəti§Such insurance plan can offer your families financial security in the event of the loss of properties.§这种保险计划可以在你失去财产的情况下向你的家人提供经济**保障**。§
20069§clip§klɪp§It is said that the U.S. produces 300 million aluminium paper clips each day.§据说美国每天生产三亿个铝制**回形针**。§
20070§apace§əˈpeɪs§The research went on apace.§研究进展**迅速**。§
20071§yield§jiːld§Higher yields have been achieved by increased irrigation and better crop breeding.§已通过增加灌溉和提高育种质量实现了**产量**的增长。§
20072§fair§feə(r)§This part of the island is warmer than the southern half, but it wouldn't be fair to say that the southern half is cold.§小岛的这部分区域比它的南部区域暖和，但是因此说南部冷是不**合理**的。§
